traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Love and value meet imagination. Heightened artistic sensibility and romantic idealism. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Seeing what you want to see in love, idealizing people, and the disillusionment that follows. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.body: It can be difficult to separate what someone has actually offered from everything you have started hoping their attention might eventually become. When Venus opposes Neptune, attraction and idealization can make possibility feel emotionally convincing long before the relationship, offer, or commitment has become equally clear. Hope is not the problem; building decisions around what has never been promised is. Let what someone consistently does carry more weight than the future you can imagine with them.
